decisions.reason: As a new lever-handle family in the firm's core category, it likely benefits from shared production and sales channels, and there is no clear sign of results falling below aspiration levels.
The mitred handle family is somewhat more style-specific, but it still fits the firm's architecture-led portfolio and can be retained while market acceptance becomes clearer.

The multifunctional door lever handle is a more uncertain innovation, yet it aligns with the firm's accessibility and system-solution direction, so boundedly rational management would usually give it more time before reallocating resources.
This door lever handle line sits close to the firm's established business, so organisational slack and low incremental complexity make continuation more likely than withdrawal.
A separately presented new collection signals strategic importance and expected planning relevance, making it unlikely to be removed so soon after launch absent clear underperformance.
A finish option is easier to rationalise away if demand disappoints, but it supports the firm's design and material-positioning strategy, so it is still more likely to be kept than dropped.
